persona: Manufacturing data scientist moving from tabular ML to computer vision
resumeText:
Ananya Iyer | Coimbatore | ananya.iyer@example.com

EXPERIENCE
Data Scientist, Kongu Manufacturing Analytics, Coimbatore (2023 - present)
- Trained a PyTorch CNN that classifies fabric images as defective or clean for the quality team.
- Used OpenCV to crop, resize and threshold 20,000 line-camera images before training.
- Report precision and recall per defect type to the plant head every week.
- Built XGBoost models in Python to predict machine downtime from sensor data.
- Keep notebooks and training scripts in a GitLab repository.

EDUCATION
MSc Data Science, PSG College of Technology, 2023

SKILLS
Python, PyTorch, OpenCV, scikit-learn, SQL, YOLO, Linux
